Before you start +

Pick one core workflow. Invite the person who does the work, its approver and the project sponsor. Use fictional or anonymised examples. Record uncertainties explicitly; this is a discovery aid, not a completed specification.

Use aggregate or fictional information. Leave out personal and confidential details.
